Hi Evan — sorry for the hiccup. Thanks for flagging the 404 and for the screenshot.

Quick diagnostic from our side: sometimes GCal/Meet embeds get rewritten when the ICS is authored by an account that uses a delegated organizer or if the external host is behind an identity gateway. To get you into the demo on time I can:

1) Create a temporary Zoom meeting and send a one-click Zoom link that doesn't rely on the embedded Meet token
2) Resend the GCal invite from a different organizer address (info@redwood-inference.com) which avoids the delegated-token rewrite

Which do you prefer? If you want Zoom I'll spin it up and post the link below — no rescheduling needed.

Ben Carter
Technical Account Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>

Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 10:18:02 -0700
Subject: RE: Demo link 404 — propose temporary Zoom bridge

FYI — we've seen the delegated-organizer token strip in a few Okra trials where the customer's calendar proxy strips unknown Meet tokens on import. Best practice: if the external tenant enforces strict calendar scrubbing, use a short-lived Zoom link or resend from our info@ organizer.

Ben — please provision Zoom and include a dial-in option (some of their IT joins via phone). Rishi — if you're ok, go ahead and update the invite with the new Zoom link and resend; include the workshop agenda again.

— Lauren
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
